### Added

- *(connectivity)* Postgres.backup — Barman Cloud plugin backups for the CNPG Cluster (ObjectStore, ScheduledBackup, WAL archiving), an opt-in Crossplane store on AWS and Azure, volume snapshots, the object-store egress, a visible no-backup state and guards in [#267](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/267) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
